summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 9 gaps in IT Asset Management app. All 25 backend API tests passed. All 9 frontend UI features verified via Playwright. All issues implemented correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Currency conversion rates are MOCKED (hardcoded in server.py) - not using live exchange rates
Password reset token is returned in API response for demo purposes - in production should be emailed
seed_data_creation: Test products, orders, tickets, and assets created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 gaps have been fixed and verified. The app now has: (1) Order confirmation dialog with qty/notes/total, (2) Product sorting with 6 options, (3) Price validation >0 on backend and frontend, (4) Stock deduction on order approval, (5) Assigned To column in Helpdesk, (6) Tenant selector for super admin in Settings, (7) Add Asset button with dialog, (8) Delete Group functionality, (9) Complete Forgot Password 3-step flow.

issue_1_order_confirmation_dialog.details: Order Now button opens confirmation dialog with product info, quantity selector (1 to stock), delivery notes textarea, total calculation, and Place Order button

issue_2_product_sorting.details: Sort dropdown with 6 options: Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Price Low-High, Price High-Low, Stock Low-High, Stock High-Low

issue_3_price_validation.details: Backend rejects price=0 with 422 error. Frontend has min=0.01 validation with hint 'Must be greater than $0'

issue_4_stock_deduction.details: Stock decreases by order quantity when order is approved via PATCH /api/orders/{id} with status=approved

issue_5_assigned_to_column.details: Helpdesk tickets table shows 'Assigned To' column between Status and Created By, showing assignee name or 'Unassigned'

issue_6_tenant_selector.details: Settings page (/tenant-settings) for super admin shows tenant dropdown selector with all tenants listed

issue_7_add_asset_button.details: Assets page has 'Add Asset' button that opens dialog with fields: Asset Tag, Serial Number, Product selector, Location, Purchase Price

issue_8_delete_group.details: DELETE /api/groups/{id} works. Returns 400 if group has assigned users. UI shows delete button per group row

issue_9_forgot_password.details: 3-step flow: (1) Email input -> (2) Token + new password inputs -> (3) Success with Go to Login. Token auto-filled in demo mode

mocked_apis.currency_conversion: Multi-currency conversion rates are hardcoded in server.py - not using live exchange rates
mocked_apis.password_reset_token: Reset token returned in API response instead of being emailed (demo mode)
